info.timeAllocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
info.description:
Objective:

The main Objective of The course is to improve economic literacy as well as critical thinking and problem solving skills to explain and predict economic issues

-Description:

Economics is The study of how The society manages its scarce resources. Economics has been divided into The subcategories of microeconomics and macroeconomics. While macroeconomics studies aggregate issues related to national and international economic activities, this course - microeconomics - focuses on The behavior of individual economic agents. microeconomics studies how households (or individuals), business (or firms, enterprises) and The government make decisions, given scarcity of resources. It also studies The interactions among those market members and how these interactions have impacts on their economic benefits and The economy. Because most of these activities occur in The markets, this course also focuses on how The markets work.
info.studentTasks:
+ Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

+ Read textbooks and other materials in advance before class

+ Access the course website (http://flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and materials of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students, and for practicing and assessment.

+ Actively participate in class activities

+ Complete all homework assignments and other tasks given by the instructor

+ Use personal laptop in class only for learning purposes

+ Don’t have private conversations or arrive at class late, which can disrupt the learning environment of the class

clos.loDetails: Discuss the theory of supply and demand
Show self-reliance when working independently and collaboratively.
Demonstrate ethical awareness and reflection in business context.
Recognize the influences of market equilibrium and disequilibrium
Describe the theory of supply and demand in real-life scenarios
Identify the tools and strategies to understand supply and demand applications
Analyze the influences of aggregate demand and aggregate supply
Understand how the government policies affect individuals, firms, and society.
Understand how the fiscal and monetary policies affect macroeconomy.
